data.name: Bhagvan
data.gender_notes: Bhagvan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhagvan is a Sanskrit term that means 'God', 'Lord', or 'Master'. It is a revered title given to various Hindu deities, including Vishnu, Shiva, and Ganesha. Bhagvan signifies the divine presence, power, and grace. The name Bhagvan carries the meaning “God, Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhagvan usually hope their child will grow to embody god, lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine presence and grace.
data.etymology: Bhagvan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God, Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhagvan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
